title: Detect contact orphans with legacy LOOKUP live-row semantics
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with find_orphans(contacts, accounts) -> list[str] replicating the contact pass of integrity_check.crms: examine live contacts only, report CONT_IDs whose ACCT_ID has no live account (LOOKUP sees live rows only, so a soft-deleted account makes its contacts orphans), ordered by CONT_ID ascending.
expected_behavior: A contact referencing a live account is not an orphan; missing, blank, or soft-deleted target accounts make a live contact an orphan; soft-deleted contacts are never reported; results are sorted by CONT_ID regardless of input order; inputs are not mutated.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, §2, §4).
security_expectations: No network or subprocess imports; pure function with no I/O or mutation of inputs.
failure_conditions: Treating a soft-deleted account as a valid referent; reporting soft-deleted contacts; unsorted or input-order-dependent results; mutating input rows.
